scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
